workload: single decode step, resident 4096 context, 24 MoE layers, 256 experts top-8, hidden 2048
change: M2/D2 fuse MoE gate/up dual GEMV + clamped SiLU into one kernel (maple_moe_dual_swiglu_bf16). NOT promoted as default: opt-in via HIPENGINE_MAPLE_FUSE_MOE=1 (default 0).

microbenchmark.method: interleaved A/B fused dual_swiglu vs (dual gemv + swiglu), 150 calls x 5 reps

correctness.gate: packed formula oracle, 12-position teacher-forced decode; fused == unfused bit-identical (same max/mean KL and top-1); GPU test asserts fused intermediate == unfused dual+swiglu intermediate bit-for-bit

notes: The fused kernel cuts decode launches 295->271 and is bit-exact, but is ~9% slower per MoE layer (229.7 vs 210.7 us). In eager mode launch savings offset the kernel regression (step wall neutral); in the hipGraph path (M1/M6) launches are already amortized so the fusion would regress ~1.4%.
Kept opt-in (HIPENGINE_MAPLE_FUSE_MOE=1) with the blocker recorded in docs/REFACTOR.md: promote only once the fused kernel's efficiency gap vs the unfused pair is eliminated.
The fused down gemv + weighted residual composite was also built, verified bit-exact, but regresses ~3.5% (serial-expert grid); reverted.
